title: EE60082: Electric Vehicles
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Electric vehicles (EV) development, past, present and future, comparison with
IC engine drive vehicles. Batteries, fuel cells, ultracapacitors. Power
converters in EV. Different types of motors used in EV and their torque-speed
characteristics, motor control techniques, high performance and efficiencyoptimized control, sensorless control. EV modeling, Tier Characteristics, slip
phenomena. Road condition estimation, driving force observer. EV motion
control: model following control, optimum slip ratio control, direct yaw
movement control, lateral motion stabilization. Fuel cell Vehicles, Hybrid
Electric Vehicles (HEV), series, parallel and series-parallel (split) systems.
